**Coaching note:**

When your opponent's piece is undefended and you can safely capture it, that's often the answer. Here Black's Ne4 has no defender. Taking it with Qxe4 wins material cleanly. Yes, Black gets an in-between check with Qf3+, but after trading queens, you're up a full knight. Always scan for hanging pieces first—they're the easiest points to win!
